description: Railway fastening clips dataset wth fastclip is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mittuniversitetet. Railway fastening clips dataset wth fastclip. This record contains a dataset with the railway fastening clip called fastclip and the installation datasheet for the same clip provided by the clip manufacturer, Pandrol AB. Coverage: Mittuniversitetet. The publisher named on the listing is Mittuniversitetet. Its keywords include järnvägstransport, rälsar, railway tracks, railway transport. The listing shows 2025-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
